en: Composite photographic postcard showing the interior of a long industrial workshop or machine shop filled with lathes, shafts, belts and other heavy machinery. Over this background are five oval portrait insets of young men in sailor uniforms, each with a cap band and a handwritten Cyrillic caption identifying the person and likely their hometown. The overall look is sepia/black‑and‑white, typical of early 20th‑century studio or school commemorative postcards.
